svg.title: OpenSoil — general-purpose LLM IoT platform
svg.desc: Platform overview showing five horizontal layers: contributor ecosystem at top, core runtime, history layer, hardware abstraction, and at the bottom three domain reference implementations — smart garden, smart home, and industrial IoT.
